newsitem.title: USA: BPA offers no power during peak hours Thursday.
newsitem.headline: BPA offers no power during peak hours Thursday.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) offered no power during peak demand hours on Thursday, the federal agency said Wednesday.
BPA continued to offer firm and non-firm power during off-peak hours at prices unchanged from Wednesday's preschedulings.
Non-firm power during off-peak blocks was offered at $12.50 per megawatt hour (MWh) for both Northwest and California-Oregon border (COB) deliveries.
Non-firm prices for hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 were unchanged at $12.50 for all deliveries, while power during hours ending 0600 and 2300 was offered at $13.50.
BPA also continued to offer displacement power for hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 PST at $9.00 per MWh and at $7.00 for Northwest buyers only.
